_note: Living World Season 3 map currencies. Gathering runs are owner-supplied numbers (2026-11-09): one map run takes 15 min (10-15 in practice; DRF refines it), once per character per day, the LOW end of the average yield per character. Counted as 1 character (owner decided 2026-11-10: no guarantee a player has or wants to use more characters). 'other_daily' (heart vendors, events, chests) only where the owner gave a number; the rest is left to DRF. Items are API item ids. The data repo carries no [fast] data: these numbers are the owner's own.

manfred._note: Manfred Njallson (Lion's Arch Aerodrome), weekly Materials section (owner 2026-11-09). Cost, weekly limit and location come from the wiki's vendor rows for each box ('Sells item' = the box), the box's contents from the wiki's 'Contains item' rows (tester feedback round 1, 2026-11-26: the planner must know the box bought and what it gives). Each source is written onto the content item with an 'offer' (the box: name, boxes per purchase, items per box). The Season 4 chest is pick-one, so its six offers share one weekly limit (cap_group).

heart_vendors._note: Heart vendor material bundles (owner's sheet 2026-11-10 named the maps and the once-a-day limit). Item -> the bundle the heart vendors sell for it. Vendors, Karma cost, locations and bundles per purchase come from the wiki's vendor rows for the bundle; items per bundle from the wiki's 'Contains item' rows (tester feedback round 1, 2026-11-26: the old sheet said 5 per pack for every map, the wiki says Jade Shards, Fire Orchid Blossoms and Orrian Pearls bundles hold 3, Petrified Wood 1, and four maps had other vendor names). Every heart vendor bundle is once a day per character (owner, in game 2026-11-26): daily_cap applies to all of them, whatever the wiki row says. One source per vendor, so each keeps its own daily limit. Counted for ONE character only. Bundle of Kralkatite (25 Kralkatite Ore for 2,688 Karma; Archivist Salwa, Priest Sazeer, Shipmate Hadhi) added 2026-11-26: the wiki has no limit, owner: once a day like the others.

owner_counts._note: Owner's in-game check 2026-11-26 beats the wiki where its rows disagree: every Ember Bay heart vendor sells one Bundle of Petrified Wood holding 3 Petrified Wood for 2,688 Karma (the wiki said 1 per bundle, and 3 bundles per purchase at two vendors).
